headline: Jefferies' 10th-inning single walks off Giants
recap: Gregg Jefferies singled to score Kevin Flora with the bases loaded in the bottom of the 10th inning, giving the Phillies an 8-7 walk-off win over the San Francisco Giants at Veterans Stadium. Flora had opened the inning with a leadoff double off reliever Jose Bautista, advanced to third on Mickey Morandini's single, and scored after Kevin Stocker drew a walk to load the bases ahead of Jefferies' hit. Heathcliff Slocumb worked a scoreless top of the 10th to earn the win; Bautista took the loss.

Phillies starter Jeff Juden lasted only 1 2/3 innings, allowing four earned runs on three hits and three walks, including solo home runs by Deion Sanders and Matt Williams. Giants starter William Van Landingham went 7 1/3 innings and was charged with three earned runs, two of them scoring in the bottom of the fourth when Andy Van Slyke came around on a Lenny Webster double and Webster scored on a Jim Eisenreich single, pulling Philadelphia within 4-2.

Pinch-hitter Kevin Jordan's two-run home run and Kevin Flora's two-run shot off Rod Beck highlighted a four-run eighth inning that put the Phillies ahead 6-5, before San Francisco answered with two runs in the top of the ninth to lead 7-6. Kevin Stocker's solo home run in the bottom of the ninth tied it at 7-7 and set up the extra-inning finish.
